additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434689-DC/Si-D/FR - [Y2 / R4 312555359091] Charger goes offline repeatedly CRM:02919000061
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0434689 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Before proceeding with troubleshooting, please ensure that the charger and router are powered on by the source. If the issue persists after the healthy supply, consider the following potential causes:
Internet Issues with the Siemens Router:
The WAN may have switched from Cellular to Ethernet due to the failover function.
A
hard reset from OCPP
(if connected to an OCPP server) or a local reboot might restore connectivity.
Mobile Network Issues:
SIM card may be disabled or expired.
Monthly data volume might be exhausted.
Signal strength could be weak due to changing radio conditions.
In M2M contracts, the IP might not be enabled.
Backend-Related Issues:
Changes in backend settings affecting the charger.
OCPP server on the backend may be unavailable.
Teltonika Router Issues:
Router may have switched to the wrong network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Potential hardware failure of the router.
Router software crash.
Additionally, please bring a spare router, SIM, and Ethernet cable during the intervention in case a replacement is needed. If the issue persists even after verifying the spare router, SIM, and Ethernet cable, they should proceed with an onsite visit, carrying a Cfast and performing a restore configuration. But make sure that all above points have been verified.
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
x
End Customer Communication
x
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
04/07/2025
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Beerpal Singh
